tokens.name: navy-950
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: HUD capsules (currency, profile), page background behind cards. `ink` reads 18:1, `ink-muted` 10:1.

tokens.name: navy-900
tokens.usage: Card base for feature cards (event, league). `ink` 16:1, `ink-muted` 9.5:1.

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: Raised HUD pill and secondary button fill. `ink` 12:1, `ink-muted` 7:1.

tokens.name: sky-600
tokens.usage: Screen background: the stadium sky behind the menu. `ink` 12:1.

tokens.name: sky-500
tokens.usage: Lighter sky band for depth layers and pressed states on `sky-600`.

tokens.name: frame-blue
tokens.usage: 1-2px stroke around standard cards and HUD pills. 4.4:1 on `navy-900`, 3.2:1 on `sky-600`. Never a text color.

tokens.name: cyan-energy
tokens.usage: Progress and XP bars, live highlights. Text on it: `navy-950` (8.3:1), never white.

tokens.name: sun-gold
tokens.usage: Brand hero color: sunburst backgrounds, coins, trophy, reward glow. Text on it: `navy-950` (10:1).

tokens.name: sun-amber
tokens.usage: Shadow side of `sun-gold` in sunbursts and coin rims. Text on it: `navy-950`.

tokens.name: badge-yellow
tokens.usage: Status badges such as COMING SOON and NEW. Text on it: `navy-950` (13.6:1). Also the focus ring (8.9:1 on `sky-600`).

tokens.name: cta-red
tokens.usage: Primary monetisation CTA (Remove ads, Buy) and card ribbons. White label 4.6:1, keep labels bold.

tokens.name: ad-red
tokens.usage: Small AD tag on sponsored buttons only. White text 8.2:1.

tokens.name: store-purple
tokens.usage: Store tile fill. White title 6.3:1.

tokens.name: reward-pink
tokens.usage: Daily reward tile fill. White title only at 24px+ bold (3.2:1); smaller text uses `navy-950` (5.7:1).

tokens.name: featured-lime
tokens.usage: Stroke and glow on the one featured mode card (Quick match). 6.8:1 on `navy-900`. Text on it: `navy-950`.

tokens.name: pitch-green
tokens.usage: Bottom utility bar and pitch-ground panels. White text 9.6:1.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons on `navy-*`, `sky-*`, `cta-red`, `store-purple`, `ad-red`, `pitch-green`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (sublabels, timers) on `navy-950`, `navy-900`, `navy-700`, `sky-600`; 6.9:1 or better on each.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Event card titles, two lines max. Uppercase.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Tile titles (Store, Daily reward), league names. Uppercase.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Currency counters and scores in HUD capsules. Roman, not italic, so digits stay legible.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Win 3 matches in a row to unlock the Elite League.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges and the AD tag. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles in the menu grid, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen edge margin and gap between card columns.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Separation between HUD row and card grid.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: AD tags, badges, progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: HUD capsules (currency, profile name).

tokens.name: stroke-card
tokens.usage: Card, tile and HUD capsule stroke width (with `frame-blue` or `featured-lime`).

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width (`badge-yellow`, 2px offset) and selected-tile outline.

tokens.name: size-shield-sm
tokens.usage: Shield logo in the HUD corner; the logo's minimum size.

tokens.name: size-logo
tokens.usage: Full logo lockup width on splash and loading; its minimum width.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum height of tappable buttons and in-match pause control.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: In-match action buttons (PASS, SHOOT, SPRINT).

tokens.name: size-joystick
tokens.usage: In-match virtual joystick base diameter.

tokens.name: size-content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the centered content column on tablet and desktop.
